follow-up time: Until beta-hCG returned to normal levels (mean 26-28 days)
exposure: High intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) ablation followed by ultrasound-guided dilation and curettage (USg-D&C)
Cesarean scar pregnancy type (CSP-I vs CSP-II)
cohort: 153 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (101 CSP-I and 52 CSP-II) who received HIFU ablation followed by USg-D&C
finding: HIFU ablation followed by USg-D&C was safe and effective in treating both CSP-I and CSP-II patients.
